messages:
Ivy (docs): I opened a small PR to clarify the quota math and swap examples to the metering v2 JSON payload. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inc/docs/pull/6230 — can folks glance at the example payload, the tier math paragraph, and the Grafana link?
Noah (eng): Quick scan: good to prefer JSON body over the old header. For the example payload, use ISO timestamp and the canonical field names. Also remove any stray commas.
Ivy (docs): Will fix timestamp and tidy the JSON. Current sample: {
  "customer_id": "acct_999",
  "usage": { "generation.tokens": 250000 },
  "timestamp": "2026-03-23T20:10:00Z"
}
Zara (product): Please don't hardcode tier bands in prose. Add a parenthetical: (see pricing page for current bands) and update the explanatory math to use variables, e.g., standard_lower=50000, standard_upper=500000.
Kai (devex): SDK snippet should reflect v3 metering API: metering.submit({ customerId, items }). Keep it 2 lines for copy-paste. Also update the Grafana link to the new panel: https://grafana.redwood/d/usage/overview?panelId=60 and add alt text note for accessibility.
Ivy (docs): Updated SDK snippet to: await metering.submit({ customerId: 'acct_999', items: [{ 'generation.tokens': 250000 }] }) and swapped the panel link + alt text: "Panel: tokens by tier (daily)".
Noah (eng): One small nit: in the tier-math worked example, show the ceiling/floor behavior explicitly (e.g., tier = floor(total_tokens / tier_size) or use ranges). That avoids confusion around border values.
Zara (product): Approved the variableized math example and the migration note: "If you previously used X-Usage-Plan header, migrate to JSON metering or the X-Redwood-Usage header; unit calculations (tokens -> tier) are unchanged." Keep it short.
Ivy (docs): Added migration blurb and a tiny old-vs-new snippet. Preview build created: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood/6230 (build 948). Merging after CI unless any objections. Thanks! :tada:
